posts.cooked:
I got Shattered Timelines a few days ago. It's the first expansion I got. I've read that Rook City and Infernal Relics will be combined into one box later, so I'll get those then.

Anyways, I played a solo game with Omnitron-X, Tempest, and Tachyon against La Capitan.

1. Tachyon had a Synaptic Interruption in play and was dealt 3 damage by La Capitan. I chose to use and destroy Synaptic Interruption to redirect that damage to La Capitan (Time Corsair). Does Synaptic Interruption go under La Capitan's character card or in Tachyon's trash?

2. Omnitron-X's Rocket Punch reads "Omnitron-X deals 1 target 2 projectile damage. Omnitron-X May deal 1 target 1 projectile Damage" Can this be used as 2 instances of damage on 1 target? It's not worded like Tempest's Chain Lightning or Bunker's Grenade Launcher ("may" and "second/third/fourth").

3. If I used Tempest's Ball Lightning to destroy a target and 2 of Maria Helena's Revenge ongoing cards were in play, could I destroy both of them before they deal each hero H minus 1 psychic damage? "You may destroy up to 2 ongoing cards" is written after and below (like separate paragraphs) the deal 1 target 4 damage...so I was wondering if that makes a difference at all.

Thanks for helping and hopefully these answers will clarify similar situations and help others too.

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
1. That's actually I good question...

2. It can in fact be used on the same target.

3. 4 damage would have to be dealt first, which if that destroys a target then Maria Helena's Revenge will interrupt and do it's damage. Then Ball Lightning can destroy the Ongoings.

Hummingbird:

I got Shattered Timelines a few days ago. It's the first expansion I got.  I've read that Rook City and Infernal Relics will be combined into one box later, so I'll get those then.

Same boat here.  I've also got the mini-expansions, did you know about those?

Anyways, I played a solo game with Omnitron-X, Tempest, and Tachyon against La Capitan.1. Tachyon had a Synaptic Interruption in play and was dealt 3 damage by La Capitan. I chose to use and destroy Synaptic Interruption to redirect that damage to La Capitan (Time Corsair). Does Synaptic Interruption go under La Capitan's character card or in Tachyon's trash?

It was not "destroyed by a villain card", but by itself, so it would go to your trash (and be a Burst therein).

  1. Omnitron-X's Rocket Punch reads "Deals Omnitron-X deals 1 target 2 projectile damage. Omnitron-X May deal 1 target 1 projectile Damage" Can this be used as 2 instances of damage on 1 target? It's not worded like Tempest's Chain Lightning or Bunker's Grenade Launcher ("may" and "second/third/fourth").

I'm semi-certain that's a "no", but I could be mistaken.  The same logic in either case would also apply to the Terrible Tech-Strike of Chrono-Ranger.

  1. If I used Tempest's Ball Lightning to destroy a target and 2 of Maria Helena's Revenge ongoing cards were in play, could I destroy both of them before they deal each hero H minus 1 psychic damage? "You may destroy up to 2 ongoing cards" is written after and below (like separate paragraphs) the deal 1 target 4 damage…so I was wondering if that makes a difference at all.

You always execute all of a card's instructions in the order written, so first you deal 4 damage to a target, and completely resolve all effects thereof, including death triggers from a target killed by the damage.  Only then, when all aftereffects of the damage are cleared, do you move on to destroy Ongoings.  (And only then, after all aftereffects of that are cleared, do you put Ball Lightning in the trash; this is effectively an invisible last line of rules text on all One-Shot cards.)

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Answers:

1.  Synaptic destroys itself, so it does not go under La Capitan.

2.  It can be used against the same target.  You are correct about the wording difference.

3.  Card text is resolved in order, so you could not do the destruction first.  

4.  You can choose which card to take out from under her.

 

Congrats on all your new toys, I remember when I got them all, good times.
